ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback, thank you for bringing this to our attention. With our warranty policy, we ask that pictures are submitted so we may get a better visual of what the issue may be and it is a part of our policy to have pictures for review on file. The pictures help provide a better understanding of what the cause may be and to better assist our Weber fans with troubleshooting their grills. 

As for your middle burner not burning, yes it could possibly not be getting enough propane to light properly or the burner tube could be clogged. If you have not recently, I suggest giving your middle burner a thorough cleaning. If the holes are clogged, that could lead to a number of issues including this one. 

Please check out the following info for some tips on cleaning the burner tubes.

1. Make sure the grill is completely cooled before removing the grates. (For larger gas grills, be sure to remove your flavorizer bars as well) 
2. Use a clean Weber Stainless Steel Grill Brush to gently brush the burner tubes in a side-to-side motion to remove any grease build-up and debris.
3. Avoid brushing lengthwise down the burner tube in order to prevent brushing grease back into the portholes.

If troubleshooting doesn't resolve the issue, the Weber Support team is here to help. Please look for an email outreach from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills
